about: MLB® The Show™ 23 gets you closer than ever to living your Baseball dreams on the diamond. Shock The Game and Own The Show™ with your favorite players, your favorite rivalries, and all your favorite MLB® moments.

Get the next-generation MLB The Show 23 experience when you play on PlayStation® 5, including the return of Stadium Creator mode, and face your friends with cross-platform play* or continue your progress on other platforms with cross progression**.
PS5 features: -Seamless performance: lose yourself in the moment with smooth, targeted 60fps gameplay.
summary: Shock The Game. Own The Show™.
